format.name: Zeiss CZI
known_gaps: JPEG (id 1), JPEG-lossless (id 3) and chunked (id >= 1000) compressed subblocks are not decoded
Multi-file CZI documents (file_part > 0) are not followed
Dimensions H, I, R, V, B with extent > 1 are reported but only index 0 is readable
Pyramid levels are listed but only full resolution is read
Complex-valued pixel types are not decoded
